description: Topics deliberately absent from the BuzzTech knowledge base (Knowledge Gaps). Questions about these must lead to an offer to raise a Ticket, never an answer. 'patterns' are case-insensitive regexes used to remove matching entries from the knowledge base and to guard against future content (including synthetic entries) covering them.
